name: CoZy CoSy
description:
Experience a scent crafted for those who appreciate depth, warmth, and timeless elegance. It opens with an irresistible blend of warm spicy accords and juicy fruity notes, creating a vibrant first impression that instantly captures attention.

As the fragrance settles, a rich heart of tobacco, sweet accords, and a soft powdery touch unfolds, adding sophistication, warmth, and a smooth, comforting character.

The dry-down is luxuriously long-lasting, where creamy vanilla, rich tobacco, woody notes, and glowing amber blend seamlessly to create a deep, sensual trail that lingers beautifully on the skin.

Bold yet refined, this fragrance is perfect for evenings, special occasions, and anyone who wants to leave an unforgettable signature wherever they go.
